reviews.title: High quality, good price RAM
reviews.comment: Good DDR5 RAM upgrade for laptops and mini pc's. I'm using this RAM in a Beelink EQR6 mini pc that has a Ryzen 6600H processor. Installed quick and easy, then booted up with no issues. Ran Memtest86+ for a few hours in a loop to confirm stability and quality. Been running the upgraded mini PC using Windows 11 for a few days now and all is good.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Excellent 16 GB SODIMM for upgrading NAS
reviews.comment: I'm using this SODIMM RAM to upgrade a UGREEN DXP4800 NAS and so far it has worked perfectly.  Remove the old 8GB stick and insert the Acer SODIMM, easy peasy.  Performance is great, now with the RAM maxed out, time to add some hard drives.
